entries.title: Ranked, Account & Android Update
changes: v0.5.0 brings major improvements to Ranked Multiplayer, a redesigned Account experience, completely revamped Android touch controls, and new account infrastructure for future progression systems.
🏆 RANKED MULTIPLAYER
Improved the Ranked Matchmaking system.
Ranked matchmaking now searches for players closest to your current rating.
Only matches played through Online Multiplayer → Ranked Matchmaking affect your rank.
Added clearer Ranked progression and presentation.
Added support for the Trainer, Leader, Elite, Champion, Great, Ultra, Master and Legend Ranked divisions.
Each rank contains multiple progression stages.
Ranked matches use a random battlefield.
Weather is disabled in Ranked matches to provide a more consistent competitive environment.
Players must be running a compatible and up-to-date version of the game before entering Ranked matchmaking.
Added a Ready timer before Ranked matches.
If a player does not select a team before the timer expires, a legal random team can be selected automatically.
Improved Ranked matchmaking and match setup reliability.
👤 ACCOUNT PAGE
Redesigned the Account page with a cleaner and more organized interface.
Improved navigation between account-related options.
Improved account status and profile information presentation.
Added support for changing your password.
Added password recovery support.
Added account deletion support.
Improved login and session handling.
Improved synchronization when account information changes while the game is running.
Account changes made on the server can now be reflected by connected clients more reliably.
🔐 ACCOUNT PROTECTION
Added stronger account session protection.
Only one active game session may use an account at a time.
Logging into the same account from another device automatically disconnects the older session.
Players now receive a message when their session is replaced by a newer login.
Password changes and account recovery actions invalidate older sessions when required.
🎒 INVENTORY SYSTEM SUPPORT
Added server-side Inventory support to player accounts.
Player inventory data can now be stored and synchronized with an account.
Inventory data is managed by the server instead of being trusted directly from the game client.
Added infrastructure for future rewards, items and progression systems.
The underlying Inventory system is now supported, but not all future Inventory-related features and rewards are available yet.
⭐ FIGURE XP & LEVELING FOUNDATION
Added account infrastructure to support individual Figure progression.
Added groundwork for future Figure XP and levels.
Figures can now be prepared to store their own progression data instead of every copy being permanently identical.
Current figures remain at their existing default level for now.
The progression system is being designed to eventually allow players to earn XP and level up individual figures.
Future Figure progression will support modifications to parts of a Pokémon's wheel and adjustments to move damage.
Future Figure upgrades will be saved permanently to the player's account.
Figure XP, leveling and wheel customization are not yet available in v0.5.0. This update adds the infrastructure required for these systems in future updates.
📱 ANDROID — NATIVE TOUCH CONTROLS
Completely reworked Android controls to use direct touchscreen input.
Removed the previous virtual and simulated mouse interaction system.
Tap buttons to select menu options, Plates, prompts and other UI controls.
Tap a Pokémon to select it.
Tap a highlighted board space to move the selected Pokémon.
Tap an eligible opposing Pokémon to initiate a battle.
Tap available choices to select Pokémon, moves, Ability targets, Plate targets and other battle prompts.
Swipe vertically to scroll through menus, Libraries, team lists and other scrollable interfaces.
Tap Back to return to the previous menu or close the current interface where applicable.
Long press acts like a mouse hover, allowing touchscreen players to view hover information.
There is no longer a need to position a mouse cursor before interacting with the game.
Improved touchscreen responsiveness and button selection.
Improved board interaction on touchscreen devices.
Improved scrolling throughout menus and Libraries.
Android and PC players continue to use the same gameplay rules and online systems.
Cross-platform multiplayer between Android and PC remains supported.
🎨 UI & QUALITY OF LIFE
Major improvements to the Account UI.
Improved menu consistency throughout the game.
Improved layouts for touchscreen interaction.
Improved spacing and sizing of several interactive elements.
Improved account-related notifications and messages.
Improved presentation of Ranked information.
Continued improvements to Team, Library and multiplayer interfaces.
🛠️ GAMEPLAY FIXES
Fixed additional player-reported Ability interactions.
Improved several special move and passive Ability interactions.
Improved handling of persistent effects during battles.
Improved movement interactions involving special Pokémon Abilities.
Fixed additional player-reported edge cases during online and offline matches.
Improved synchronization of gameplay information during online matches.
📜 PATCH NOTES
